page.overview:
Who is Mikka Stone?

Sonya Blade|Enemies=Black Dragon Kano|Alignment=Good}}

Lieutenant Mikka Stone or Lt. Mikka Stone is a character who appeared in the Mortal Kombat Special Forces Comics. Mikka is a member of Jax's squad, along with Sonya Blade, Sylence, Torque and Vapor.
